name: std/memory
description: Declares owned allocations and grouped arena lifetimes.
readme: Declares owned allocations and grouped arena lifetimes.
Import this module with use memory.

files.content:
-- Declares owned allocations and grouped arena lifetimes.
public define Allocator as opaque.
public use "memory" function system giving pointer to Allocator.
public use "memory" function arena giving failable pointer to Allocator.
public use "memory" function allocate(allocator pointer to Allocator, size unsigned) giving failable pointer to byte.
public use "memory" function release(allocator pointer to Allocator, buffer pointer to byte) giving failable nothing.
public use "memory" function expand(allocator pointer to Allocator, buffer pointer to byte, size unsigned) giving failable pointer to byte.
public use "memory" function copy(allocator pointer to Allocator, buffer pointer to byte, content text) giving failable nothing.
public use "memory" function view(allocator pointer to Allocator, buffer pointer to byte, size unsigned) giving failable text.
public use "memory" function close(allocator pointer to Allocator) giving failable nothing.
public use "memory" function transfer(source sequence of constant byte, destination sequence of byte) giving failable nothing.
public use "memory" function clear(buffer sequence of byte) giving nothing.
public use "memory" function compare(left sequence of constant byte, right sequence of constant byte) giving integer.
public use "memory" function identical[T](left pointer to T, right pointer to T) giving boolean.
